verdict.rationale: Buzz has its own workflow automation inside the chat tool: agents and users can 'run workflows', the CLI documents `buzz workflows trigger` and `buzz workflows approve`, and workflow runs are searchable alongside conversations. However, the vision describes this as 'YAML-as-code automation' rather than a no-code builder, and only manual CLI triggering is evidenced. missing for 10: a no-code visual workflow builder for admins, event-based triggers, schedule/cron triggers, form-submission triggers, in-depth workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
